s: Din haoseh tzerakayv verotzeh leekol, ubo g' seipim: haoseh tzerakayv verotzeh leekol — yittol b' peamim, rishona yittol netila sheenah maksheret laakila, ella lenaqqot yadayv lebarek "asher yatzar", usheniyya netila keshera lebarek "al netilat yadayim", sheim yittol netila achat keshera vibarek techilla "asher yatzar" (mippene shennitchayyeb bah techilla, veod shehi tedira), veachar kak "al netilat yadayim" — yihyeh hepseq ben netila lebirkatah. Veap im yebarek techilla "al netilat yadayim" veachar kak "asher yatzar", mikkol maqom yihyeh hepseq ben netila le"hammotzi", veyesh oserim lehapsiq benehem bedibre eseq veinyan acher, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"v. Veim eno rotzeh littol ella paam achat — yebarek "asher yatzar" miyyad keshemmeshapshep yadayv lenaqqotan milliklukan leachar sheshshapak alehen shetipa rishona, sheaz yadayv kesherot libraka, abal enan kesherot laakila ad sheyyishpok alehen mayim sheniyyim, veaz yebarek "al netilat yadayim" bishat hanniggub, shebbeinyan zeh en kan hepseq ben netila lebirkatah, velo ben netila le"hammotzi", ki lo nigmera hannetila ad sheshshapak alehem mayim sheniyyim, ukegon sheshshapak al shette yadayv keachat, sheim lo ken en yakol leshapshepan zo bazo ad sheyyishpok alehem mayim sheniyyim, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"b. Umikkol maqom, yoter nakon littol b' peamim, lepi sherob peamim regilin lishpok rebiit bebat achat al b' yadayv o al kol achat bipne atzmah bishtipa rishona, veshub en tzarik mayim sheniyyim letaharan, veyesh kan hepseq. Veim natal netila achat keshera veshakach lebarek ad sheshshapak mayim sheniyyim, o sheshshapak rebiit bebat achat — lo yebarek techilla "asher yatzar" veyachazor veyittol shenit vibarek "al netilat yadayim", lepi shekkebar yatza yede chobato bannetila harishona, veeno yakol lebarek "al netilat yadayim" al netila hashsheniyya bilbaddah, kevan sheeno mechuyyab bah, veim yebarek al netila harishona achar hashsheniyya — nimtza shehipsiq ben netila lebirkatah. Ella yebarek techilla "al netilat yadayim" al netila zo lebaddah, veachar kak "asher yatzar", shebbirkat "asher yatzar" enah chashuba hepseq ben netila le"hammotzi", kevan shelletohorat yadayim hi baa gam ken. (Abal ben netila lebirkatah yesh lachosh yoter lehepseq, mittaam shennitbaer besiman qn"ch. Veod, sheyyesh bazo shette hapsaqot: ben netila lebirkatah, uben netila le"hammotzi"). Veotan hannizharin millehasiach ben netilat yadayim le"hammotzi" umesichin ben netilat yadayim lebirkatah — toim hem, vetzarik lehazhiram shello yasichu kelal. Veim oseh tzerakayv beemtza hasseuda, kevan sheen tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" — en tzarik littol yadayv ella paam achat. Veen lachosh lehapsaqat "asher yatzar" ben netila laakila, ki apillu ben netila le"hammotzi" yesh mattirin behepseq muat kazeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"v, veen chosheshin ledibre haoserim ella ben netila le"hammotzi", mippene sheameru chakamim: kol hattokep birkat "hammotzi" lintila — eno nizzoq bekol otah seuda, abal kesheen sham birkat "hammotzi" — en tzarik lizzaher ella mehepseq gadol haasur ledibre hakkol, mippene taqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu tekep lintilat yadayim seuda, kemo sheyyitbaer sham, ukemo shennitbaer besiman qs"d:

Akal dabar shechayyab lebarek "bore nepashot rabbot" beraka acharona, veshakach vehetil mayim — yebarek techilla "asher yatzar" veachar kak "bore nepashot rabbot", mippene shebbirkat "asher yatzar" tedira yoter, vekol hattadir mechabero — qodem lachabero:

Im rabbim mesubbin basseuda, haggadol notel yadayv techilla, mippene kebodo. Ella sheqqetzat gedolim regilin littol baacharona, shello lehapsiq bishhiyya ad sheyyittelu kullam, veshello ledabber dibre eseq veinyan acher, kemo sheyyitbaer siman qasv:
